Bow & Arrow Shot by dorkster, a remix of qubodup Swish - bamboo stick weapon swhoshes and Arrow hit twang; Arrow hit twang derives from remaxim Vibrating Plastic.
https://opengameart.org/content/bow-arrow-shot
https://opengameart.org/content/swish-bamboo-stick-weapon-swhoshes
https://opengameart.org/content/arrow-hit-twang

The included bow-release.ogg is unmodified. Its source and license remain available in this directory.

Other feedback recordings: Vehicle / Jan Schupke, Tinysized SFX Library, CC0.
